hypotheses.description: A malformed or corrupted payload was written to cache key 'poison:session:abc123', triggering JSONDecodeError whenever api-gateway attempts to deserialize it.
A schema mismatch or unhandled serialization format between cache writers and api-gateway caused non-JSON data to be stored under the session cache key.
An application bug or injection vulnerability permitted an invalid session payload to be cached directly, producing downstream decoding errors.

ground_truth.root_cause: Malformed JSON under poison:session:abc123 crashes every reader
ground_truth.debugging_skill: Error signature → key identification → targeted DEL (not FLUSHALL)
